trustBar.heading: Why clinics trust Bella
items: Trusted by 200+ clinics across Egypt & Gulf

items.a: Mesotherapy is a minimally invasive technique involving micro-injections of active ingredients (vitamins, peptides, hyaluronic acid) directly into the skin's mesoderm layer. This targeted delivery bypasses the skin barrier, ensuring therapeutic concentrations reach exactly where they are needed.

Most clients describe the sensation as a slight tingling or pressure. Sessions use ultra-fine needles (30–32G) and optional numbing cream. The discomfort is minimal and short-lived — far less than most people expect.

items.q: How many sessions do I need?
items.a: A typical protocol is 4–6 sessions spaced 1–2 weeks apart for initial results, followed by monthly maintenance. Your practitioner will design a specific protocol based on your skin's response and goals.

items.q: How soon will I see results?
items.a: Many clients notice improved radiance and hydration after the first 1–2 sessions. Deeper concerns (fine lines, pigmentation, laxity) show progressive improvement across 4–8 sessions as collagen synthesis and cellular renewal accelerate.

Every Bella formula is manufactured under pharmaceutical-grade conditions with full traceability of every active ingredient. We use zero parabens, formaldehyde releasers, or synthetic fragrances. All products undergo stability and microbiological testing before release.

story.headline: Where science met a vision.
story.p1: Bella was founded in Egypt with a singular belief: that the region's clients deserved access to the same precision formulations used in the world's most prestigious clinics.
story.p2: Our founders — a team of dermatologists and biochemists — spent three years developing formulations that meet clinical-grade standards while maintaining the ritual experience of luxury skincare.
story.p3: Today, Bella is trusted by aesthetic practitioners across Egypt and the Gulf, and used in clinics that set the benchmark for skin excellence.
